observations.claim: Prepare is ready only for PASS+complete+ready_for_next_phase. A blocked prepare returns ok=false/converged=false; a later invocation runs prepare again unless the reviewer-approved prepare handoff is ready.

At step resume, _completed_step_report_from_workspace accepts a cached result from stored hook/review reports when hook status, review_status and prefinish_contract status are PASS and returned_to_worker is not true; it then returns the stored review payload.

execute_step_with_prefinish_review calls the cached-completion check before building the current step ArtifactRegistry or running current deterministic/agent review hooks. If a cached report is returned, it records step_resume_skip and continues as 'previously passed'.
The public test test_execute_step_resumes_previously_passed_step_without_worker explicitly asserts that worker and reviewer are skipped for the previously passed step.
Prepare BLOCKED evidence_paths are deterministically required to remain inside the workspace and to exist, but this blocker-path validation checks path existence rather than a content digest.

protocol_implication: CACHED_PASS_REPLAY_REVALIDATION: cached scientific completion is a capability token only for an unchanged approval context; conservative rerun is always valid.

risk_boundary.not_supported: This inspection does not prove every possible post-approval mutation reaches final global convergence undetected; later phase-level logic may catch some mutations. The demonstrated gap is specifically the pre-skip step-level replay predicate.
risk_boundary.supported: The step-level cached-PASS reuse predicate itself is status/path based and, before skip, does not bind reuse to a fresh digest of the current plan step, verifier revision, checked-artifact membership or checked-artifact bytes. Therefore a replay protocol should invalidate cached PASS on any such drift.
